title: Design Studio Selections Option Deposit Refund Percentages and Closing Credit
content:
When a purchase agreement ends without closing, the option deposits held on its Design Studio Selections file are refunded at the package percentages below; when the home closes, option deposits are credited against the amount due at closing where the package so provides.

| Package | Refund on a buyer cancellation before structural close (percent) | Refund on a cancellation after structural close (percent) | Refund on a cancellation for rescission or builder delay (percent) | Option deposits credited against the amount due at closing |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Studio Essentials | 50 | 0 | 100 | Yes |
| Studio Classic | 50 | 0 | 100 | Yes |
| Studio Select | 75 | 0 | 100 | Yes |
| Studio Designer | 75 | 0 | 100 | Yes |
| Studio Signature | 90 | 0 | 100 | Yes |
| Studio Atelier | 100 | 0 | 100 | Yes |

**Notes**

- The before-structural-close percentage applies to a buyer's cancellation other than a rescission or a builder delay.
- The after-structural-close percentage is 0 on every package.
- Every package credits option deposits against the amount due at closing.
